title: 2016 LLVM Developers’ Meeting: D. Dunbar “A New Architecture for Building Software”
summary: Daniel Dunbar of Apple presents llbuild, a framework for building build systems, at the 2016 LLVM Developers' Meeting. He argues that the traditional way C compilers integrate with build systems limits compile speed, and proposes a new architecture.
why: Cited in build-system and C++ compile-time threads as Apple's work on incremental builds and the design behind llbuild.
